##Synopsis##

Shallow area of low pressure over northeast England will track southeast and fill. Ridge of high pressure builds tomorrow.


##Wind##

North or northeast 2 to 4, becoming variable 3 or less in places overnight, then north or northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##
